model_metadata.jurisdiction: Bangladesh (ICT Act, Cybersecurity Act, Sovereign Data Residency)
model_metadata.mandatory_architecture: Next.js 15 App Router (TypeScript, RSC) + FastAPI (Async ASGI) + PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7

trust_boundaries.name: SAP SFTP Ingress Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Ingress interface for automated file transfers of ERP batch runs, manufacturing plant volumes, and delivery dispatches from SAP on-premise servers.
trust_boundaries.protocol: SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) over TLS/SSH Port 22

trust_boundaries.name: Meta WhatsApp Webhook Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Ingress callback interface handling real-time dealer inquiries, automated dispatch confirmations, and field agent communications.
trust_boundaries.protocol: HTTPS POST over TLS 1.3 with X-Hub-Signature-256

trust_boundaries.name: Enterprise REST API Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Internal and client-facing asynchronous ASGI endpoints serving Next.js 15 React Server Components, authenticated operational portals, and metrics visualizers.
trust_boundaries.protocol: HTTPS REST over TLS 1.3 with JWT Bearer Authentication & RBAC
trust_boundaries.source_network: Enterprise Browser Clients / Next.js Server Components

threat_analysis.title: Rogue SFTP Client Impersonation
threat_analysis.description: An adversary impersonates the SAP production facility server to inject fraudulent plant output batches or manipulate inventory numbers.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Stolen credentials, brute-forced weak passwords, or compromised SSH keys.
mitigation_controls: Enforce Ed25519 asymmetric SSH key authentication with keys managed exclusively via HashiCorp Vault.
Disable password authentication completely on the SFTP server.
Enforce IP whitelisting restricted strictly to authorized factory gateways in Bangladesh.
Automate SSH key rotation every 30 days via Vault dynamic secrets.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Audit log streaming of all SSH connection attempts to SIEM with geo-IP anomaly alerting.

threat_analysis.title: Batch Ingestion File Manipulation & Malicious Payloads
threat_analysis.description: An attacker alters CSV/XML manufacturing manifests in transit or replaces batches with poisoned inventory data.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) or unauthorized write access to SFTP drop directories.
mitigation_controls: Cryptographic SHA-256 checksum validation for every batch file accompanied by GPG digital signatures.
Pydantic strict schema parsing and sanitization before staging into PostgreSQL 16.
Files processed in transient memory; raw files moved to encrypted WORM (Write Once, Read Many) cold storage.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Hash mismatch alarms and immediate pipeline freeze upon corrupted batch checksum.

threat_analysis.title: Denial of Factory Batch Dispatch
threat_analysis.description: A plant dispatcher or logistics vendor denies having generated or uploaded an errant production manifest.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Absence of non-repudiation audit logs on SFTP ingestion.
mitigation_controls: Immutable append-only audit trail in PostgreSQL 16 logging file SHA-256, byte size, client IP, timestamp, and SSH fingerprint.
Automated cryptographic receipt returned to SAP ERP upon successful batch validation.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Daily reconciliation reports matched between SAP ERP logs and Nerolac Dash audit tables.

threat_analysis.title: Exposure of Proprietary Paint Formulas & Volume Pricing
threat_analysis.description: Industrial competitors gain unauthorized access to paint formulation codes, factory capacity, or batch costs stored in transit files.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Unencrypted file staging directories, insecure permission bits (777), or leaked SFTP backup folders.
mitigation_controls: End-to-end file encryption at rest using AES-256-GCM with keys managed by HashiCorp Vault.
Strict POSIX permissions (0600) on all incoming staging directories.
Automated purging of local staging files immediately after ingestion into PostgreSQL 16.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Vault access audit logs alerting on any unauthorized secret read.

threat_analysis.title: Disk Exhaustion & Ingestion Pipeline Starvation
threat_analysis.description: Excessive or oversized file uploads exhaust local storage or compute resources, halting plant operational feeds.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Upload of multi-gigabyte decompression bombs or high-frequency automated file dumps.
mitigation_controls: Hard quota limit of 25MB per batch file enforced at SFTP daemon layer.
Redis-backed token bucket rate limiter restricting uploads to max 10 files per minute per plant.
Isolated ephemeral disk volume with auto-scaling alerts at 75% capacity.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Real-time Prometheus disk space and ingestion queue length monitoring.

threat_analysis.title: SFTP Chroot Jail Escape
threat_analysis.description: An attacker exploits vulnerabilities in the SFTP server to gain interactive shell access on the underlying Linux host.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: SSH daemon vulnerabilities, weak chroot isolation, or symlink traversal.
mitigation_controls: Strict internal-sftp chroot jail configuration with ForceCommand internal-sftp and PermitTTY no.
Containerized unprivileged Docker container running as non-root user with read-only root filesystem.
AppArmor / SELinux mandatory access controls restricting kernel system calls.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Host auditd rules triggering alerts on any shell execution or forbidden syscall attempt.

threat_analysis.title: Forged WhatsApp Webhook Invocations
threat_analysis.description: Malicious actors craft synthetic HTTP requests to the webhook URL pretending to be Meta servers confirming fake paint orders.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Unauthenticated HTTP POST requests targeting the public webhook endpoint.
mitigation_controls: Cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 signature verification validating the X-Hub-Signature-256 header against the app secret stored in HashiCorp Vault.
Reject requests with missing, invalid, or expired signatures immediately with HTTP 401.
Verify challenge tokens during webhook registration handshake with Vault verify tokens.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Security logs recording all failed signature verifications with source IP tracking.

threat_analysis.title: Replay Attacks on Order Confirmation Webhooks
threat_analysis.description: An attacker intercepts and replays valid WhatsApp order confirmation messages to duplicate inventory deductions.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: HTTP payload replay without timestamp or nonce validation.
mitigation_controls: Redis 7 distributed idempotency cache storing message IDs with a 24-hour TTL.
Verify WhatsApp message timestamp is within 300 seconds of current UTC time.
Idempotent database upsert transactions in PostgreSQL 16.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Duplicate message ID metrics incremented and monitored on Grafana dashboards.

threat_analysis.title: Dealer Disputing WhatsApp Order or Dispatch Acceptance
threat_analysis.description: A dealer claims they never placed an order or acknowledged dispatch receipt via WhatsApp.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Incomplete conversational audit trail or lack of non-repudiation records.
mitigation_controls: Store complete cryptographic WhatsApp message audit records including Meta message ID, sender WABA ID, timestamp, and payload hash.
Maintain dealer phone number to verified dealer ID mapping in PostgreSQL 16.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Permanent message audit ledger preserved for 7 years per Bangladesh corporate guidelines.

threat_analysis.title: PII Leakage in Customer & Dealer Chat Logs
threat_analysis.description: Bangladeshi phone numbers (+880...), National ID numbers (NID), or bank account figures are logged or sent to LLM context windows.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Application logging, crash tracebacks, or unredacted LLM inference queries.
mitigation_controls: Mandatory PIIMaskingMiddleware and PIIRedactingFormatter in src/backend/middleware/pii_masker.py.
Regex-based automatic scrubbing of all Bangladeshi phone numbers, NID formats, and bank figures before writing to logs or LLM context.
Strict enforcement of Bangladesh Data Sovereignty in src/backend/config/settings.py.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Automated log auditing and regex compliance test assertions in CI/CD pipelines.

threat_analysis.title: Webhook Flooding & Async ASGI Worker Starvation
threat_analysis.description: High volume of webhook requests overwhelms FastAPI ASGI workers or exhausts database connection pools.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Distributed DoS or bot spam targeting the public webhook URL.
mitigation_controls: Asynchronous webhook ingestion: return HTTP 200 immediately after HMAC validation and queue processing in Redis 7.
Cloudflare WAF / Cloud DDoS protection with rate-limiting at 100 req/sec per IP.
Connection pool caps on PostgreSQL 16 with asyncpg pooling.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: ASGI event loop latency alerts and Redis queue backlog depth metrics.

threat_analysis.title: Unauthenticated Command Execution via Chatbot Prompt Injection
threat_analysis.description: An attacker uses crafted prompts in WhatsApp messages to override system prompts and execute administrative actions in the backend.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Prompt injection targeting the downstream LLM processing pipeline.
mitigation_controls: Strict separation between user input and system instructions via structured Pydantic tool parameters.
Deterministic rule-based intent routing before LLM invocation.
Administrative actions strictly blocked from WhatsApp channel regardless of prompt output.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Anomaly detection on unexpected LLM tool calls with immediate session termination.

threat_analysis.title: JWT Token Forgery or Tampering
threat_analysis.description: An attacker generates arbitrary JWT tokens using weak signing algorithms or compromised keys to access dealer accounts.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: JWT alg=none vulnerability, weak HMAC secrets, or leaked private keys.
mitigation_controls: Enforce RS256 / EdDSA asymmetric token signing with keys stored exclusively in HashiCorp Vault.
Explicit validation rejecting 'none' algorithm and enforcing strict token expiration (max 15 mins for access tokens).
Redis-backed token revocation blacklist for immediate session invalidation.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Alerting on any JWT verification failure with invalid algorithm header.

threat_analysis.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) & State Manipulation
threat_analysis.description: An attacker tricks an authenticated dashboard user's browser into executing state-changing transactions.
mitigation_controls: Enforce SameSite=Strict on all authentication cookies.
Strict CORS origin policy allowing only verified internal Nerolac domains.
State-changing endpoints require explicit anti-CSRF custom headers.

threat_analysis.title: Untracked Administrative Configuration Changes
threat_analysis.description: An admin updates production plant targets or dealer credit limits and subsequently denies the action.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Missing change audit logs on administrative endpoints.
mitigation_controls: Comprehensive audit middleware recording user ID, IP address, timestamp, previous state, and updated state in PostgreSQL 16.
Audit records are write-only and immutable.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Weekly automated audit log integrity verification.

threat_analysis.title: Cross-Tenant Dealer Data Leakage (BOLA / IDOR)
threat_analysis.description: A dealer accesses other competing dealers' sales figures or inventory discounts by guessing order IDs or dealer IDs.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Broken Object-Level Authorization (OWASP API Top 10 BOLA).
mitigation_controls: Strict tenant-scoped database queries enforcing WHERE dealer_id = current_user.dealer_id on every data query.
UUIDv4 identifiers for orders and shipments preventing sequential enumeration.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced via FastAPI dependency injection.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Security alarms on 403 Forbidden spikes indicating enumeration attempts.

threat_analysis.title: GraphQL / Heavy Analytics Query Exhaustion
threat_analysis.description: Resource-intensive queries request aggregate sales data over massive date ranges, saturating PostgreSQL 16 CPU and memory.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Unbounded complex query filters and lack of pagination.
mitigation_controls: Enforce strict pagination (max 100 records per page) with Pydantic validation.
Database statement timeout set to 5000ms on all analytics read queries.
High-performance Redis 7 caching for aggregate dashboard KPI metrics.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: PostgreSQL slow query logging alerting on queries exceeding 1000ms.

threat_analysis.title: Privilege Escalation via Mass Assignment
threat_analysis.description: A standard dealer user includes 'role': 'SUPER_ADMIN' or 'credit_limit': 9999999 in profile update payload.
threat_analysis.threat_vector: Mass assignment vulnerability on user or dealer update endpoints.
mitigation_controls: Strict Pydantic v2 schemas with extra='forbid' rejecting unapproved fields.
Dedicated update schemas excluding administrative fields (roles, permissions, credit limits).
Role elevation restricted exclusively to multi-factor authenticated internal administration portals.
threat_analysis.monitoring_and_audit: Immediate notification to Security Operations Center on any forbidden role modification attempt.
